summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to route between lan-a (node2, eth1) and lan-b (node3, eth2) subnets 10.50.10.0/24 and 10.50.20.0/24, with static routes on node2/node3 pointing to node1 as gateway for the peer subnet. No NAT was applied, so original source addresses are preserved. Verified ICMP and arbitrary-port TCP connectivity in both directions. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3) one at a time, confirming boot ID changes and post-restart persistence of interface config, routes, and end-to-end connectivity with source-address preservation intact.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline network topology on node1/node2/node3 via ip addr/route
Identified VyOS eth1/eth2 <-> node2/node3 enp8s0 mapping via tcpdump ARP capture
Configured node1 VyOS: eth1=10.50.10.254/24 (lan-a), eth2=10.50.20.254/24 (lan-b), firewall forward filter default-drop with accept rules eth1<->eth2
Configured node2: systemd-networkd static Address 10.50.10.10/24 on enp8s0 plus static route to 10.50.20.0/24 via node1
Configured node3: systemd-networkd static Address 10.50.20.10/24 on enp8s0 plus static route to 10.50.10.0/24 via node1
Verified bidirectional ICMP and TCP (nc) connectivity between node2 and node3 with tcpdump confirming original source IPs preserved (no NAT)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially, polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id each time
Re-verified interface config, static routes, and end-to-end connectivity with source-address preservation after all three restarts
Cleaned up temporary test files/processes on all nodes

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port via node1 routing
evidence.summary: VyOS eth1/eth2 configured and firewall rules committed; ping and arbitrary TCP port (12345) traffic succeeded in both directions between node2 (10.50.10.10) and node3 (10.50.20.10)
tcpdump on node3's LAN interface shows ICMP packets from node2 with unmodified source IP 10.50.10.10, both before and after node restarts, confirming pure routing with no NAT applied

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9...; reboot issued; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id 7451f01f... on reconnect; VyOS interface config (eth1/eth2 addresses) confirmed persisted post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfeb3b70...; reboot issued; new boot_id 0099ce2e... on reconnect; enp8s0 static address, routes, and ping to node3 confirmed working post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot issued; new boot_id f9645d62... on reconnect; enp8s0 static address, routes, ping to node2, and source-IP-preserving tcpdump capture confirmed working post-reboot
